checks.detail: Independent ODE matches all four analytic curves; zero and unit equilibria retained.
Piecewise derivatives agree on both sides and at joining times; sqrt RHS has unbounded difference quotient at zero.
Exact algebra verifies x prime=x^2 and unbounded limit at tau=1; no continuation through the pole claimed.
Bounded invariant interval and explicit derivative bound support the finite-time Gronwall inequality.
A separately chosen first-order linear model verifies particular plus homogeneous structure.
Both displacement and velocity match the independently differentiated resonant closed form.
Independent scalar maximization checks the peak formula and observation-variable scope.
Independent IVP integrations and matrix-exponential composition check all four phase portraits.
Eigenvalue signs and exact center return agree with node/focus/saddle/center labels.
Exact nilpotent factor gives 10*tau*exp(-tau); negative eigenvalues do not force monotone norm decay.
A concrete time-ordered product differs from exp(integral A); constant-matrix formula not generalized blindly.
Exact +/-x^3 solutions confirm different behavior despite identical Jacobian zero.
Chain-rule identity, conservation/dissipation and the specified V<2 potential well independently checked.
RK45 integrated loss plus terminal potential/kinetic energy agrees with initial energy.
Independent full nonlinear Cartesian solve agrees with exact radius and angle on both sides of cycle.
Stable origin, critical algebraic decay and stable nonzero radius all checked across mu signs.
Actual upward events verify period pi; independent finite difference of return radius matches exp(-2*pi).
A fixed pi/2 phase offset persists although radii converge; attraction is to the orbit set.
Real equilibria only for mu>=0 in saddle-node; stability derivatives and pitchfork branches verified directly, avoiding source sign typo.
Nonzero angular frequency and real-part derivative one verified; radial cubic supplies the nondegenerate supercritical sign.
Algebraic roots, exact rational multiplier 4/25 and independent iteration agree for r=3.2.
Exact special orbit and symmetric preimages separate map behavior from an ODE time-one flow.

detail.scope: Finite samples complement established theory; not proof that every initial condition is chaotic.

checks.detail: Independent finite differences and three analytic equilibria verify equations and constant divergence; no chaos inference from divergence alone.
Independent algorithms agree at short time; a separate variational solve checks infinitesimal response, without long-time pointwise guarantee.
Common initial field, fixed ends and the wave half-time zero field verified.
Independent centered space/time differences check both exact modal solutions at interior points.
Independent spatial quadrature verifies constant total energy and nonzero half-time velocity.
Orthogonality formula, independent quadrature and monotone norm decay agree for the fixed-end diffusion example.
Fast decay has step restriction; forward Euler multiplies undamped oscillator energy by 1+4h^2 despite exact conservation.

scope: Specified normalized models; finite computations complement arguments, not general certified proofs; professional review pending.
